findings.body: The diff adds `pub reasoning_effort: String` with no `#[serde(default)]`. If the `Models` struct (not shown in the diff) derives `serde::Deserialize` — which is typical for a type in `src/config/types.rs` that is validated by `src/config/validate.rs` — every existing config file that does not contain a `reasoning_effort` key will fail to deserialize after this change. That is a regression for any user upgrading with an existing config. I could not confirm whether the struct has `#[serde(default)]` at the container level or whether the field is populated another way, because the struct definition header and its derive macros are outside the diffed region and were not returned by any lookup. If the container has `#[serde(default)]`, the field would silently default to `""`, which is not one of the documented valid values (`off`, `low`, `medium`, `high`) and would pass an invalid string to `reasoning_options` in `openrouter.rs`.
findings.title: New config field may break deserialization of existing configs

value.summary: The diff adds a `reasoning_effort: String` field to the config struct in `src/config/types.rs` with a doc comment. The change is a doc-only addition from the diff's perspective, but adding a required field to a config struct risks breaking deserialization of existing config files and any in-code struct-literal construction sites. I could not confirm the struct's serde attributes or all construction sites from the evidence provided.
